help: 一组客人一个色块，显示称呼、备注和人数。重叠预约并排显示；点击色块查看详情，点击空白时段筛选预约。待确认预约不占用已确认名额。

Each block shows one group's name, notes and guest count. Overlapping bookings appear side by side. Select a block for details or an empty slot to filter bookings. Pending bookings do not use confirmed capacity.
